chapter: Chicago and New York with Louis Armstrong, 1925-30
title: Louis leaves Dickerson's band and joins Luis Russell
summary: Louis left Connie's Inn and the Dickerson band without warning, leaving the men stranded and short of fare to Chicago, and joined Luis Russell's band, booked by Rockwell.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well what did they do?
They just had to get back to Chicago and get jobs. They just, Louis just left the band flat.
Like Crawford Worthington (list) he went with Mills Blue Rhythm Band. And who else, somebody else was in that band.

Jimmy Strong, he was up to our house crying because he hardly had fare to get back to Chicago. And so many of them they didn't even have the fare back to Chicago. But Zutty was all set because when Louis cut out from Connie's Inn, Louis wanted Zutty out of that band.
When Louis cut out what did he do? Did he get, go with Louis Russel's band then?
That's right.
That's right. That's when he went with Louis Russel
And he didn't explain any of it to the boys in the band.
Why did he do that?
I don't know. He just,........
Said he told us that night, he said, you know I'm going to become commercial. I
can make some money. But I believe he didn't treat the band right.
Well what I don't quite understand was, what was the advantage of taking Louis Russel's band rather than the band he'd got?
Well because it seems to me that I think that Rockwell was booking Louis Russel's band.
I see, yes.
Yes, and he put Louis with Louis Russel' band.
Yes, yes.
Red Allen was in that band, Louis Russel's band.
And it was a big band.
Albert Nicholas, Nicholas, Paul Barbarin, Pops Foster, Charlie Holmes.
Yes and Albert Nicholas.

And Louis. Louis hadn't even talked to Zutty about what was he going to do? He didn't know what Zutty was going to do. Because Zutty said, boy I'm going to talk to Louis. You know, because they were friends for so many years and they came here together. And I said, if Louis wanted you Zutty he'd

talk to you. I wouldn't go to see him. Oh yes, I want to talk to him. I want to see what he's going to do. Made me mad. So we went down there and that's the only way we found out for sure that Louis was through with him with Carroll Dickerson's band. And Zutty was set. Because Carnie's Inn, the girls wanted Zutty. Everybody in there wanted Zutty see but they didn't want the rest of the band. It was Ally Ross (Al Roth?) band. And Ally was, he liked Zutty too. And he wanted Zutty.
